briefdescription.para: Find a point in code which dominates all given instructions.

detaileddescription.para: We can safely assume that, whatever fact we can prove at the found point, this fact is also true for each of the given instructions.

briefdescription.para: Return true if this instruction generates a simple SCEV expression in terms of that IV.

detaileddescription.para: This is similar to IVUsers' isInteresting() but processes each instruction non-recursively when the operand is already known to be a simpleIVUser.

briefdescription.para: Determine the insertion point for this user.

detaileddescription.para: By default, insert immediately before the user. SCEVExpander or LICM will hoist loop invariants out of the loop. For PHI nodes, there may be multiple uses, so compute the nearest common dominator for the incoming blocks. A nullptr can be returned if no viable location is found: it may happen if User is a PHI and Def only comes to this PHI from unreachable blocks.
